ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with a low global contrast ratio; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized and constitute approximately 5-8% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) contiguous blobs are localized at the terminal tips of both the left and right lobes. A distinct high-contrast curvilinear white mark is situated on the lower-inner quadrant of the left lobe. Discrete punctate white spots are non-uniformly distributed across the central low-intensity regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees; the apex is well-defined and sharp.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular edge topography; the left lobe trailing edge displays high-amplitude, jagged peaks and deep valleys (approx. 10-15 pixel depth), while the right lobe trailing edge shows a higher frequency of lower-amplitude (2-5 pixel depth) serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve following the leading edge from the midline, sweeping outwards and upwards to the fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular white pixel aggregates concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes; isolated smaller circular clusters are visible across the mid-ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, high-contrast white curvilinear abrasion located on the lower interior of the left lobe. Several smaller, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are scattered across the black surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant curvilinear scar on the inner left lobe. Irregular tissue loss and jagged serration on the distal trailing edge of the left lobe. Heavy white scarring clusters at both terminal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific high-contrast white mark on the left lobe provides a highly unique visual identifier against the predominantly dark background.
